description: 경기도_자전거도로 집계 현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels and cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 내 자전거도로의 설치 및 관리 현황을 집계한 자료로, 전용도로, 보행자겸용도로, 전용차로, 자전거우선도로 등 다양한 유형의 노선 수와 연장 길이, 정비 예산 정보를. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 자전거도로, 교통인프라, 친환경교통, 자전거이용, 도로연장. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
